episode.title: I Found UNNATURAL PLASTIC... And It STARTED To SHIFT COLORS!

synopsis: A man handles a piece of ordinary plastic that spontaneously and continuously shifts through a spectrum of vibrant colors, independent of light or manipulation.
narration: I picked up this plastic square, and it just started changing colors all on its own. It's not the light, I've tried moving it everywhere. It just cycles through the whole spectrum, and it's almost like it's trying to...

shots.prompt: Close-up, Ihsan (characters: ihsan_maker, wearing a plain black crew-neck t-shirt) holds a small, rectangular piece of ordinary-looking white plastic in his palm. The plastic slowly, smoothly shifts its color from a muted blue to a soft green, like an internal aurora. His fingers gently trace its surface, his expression calm and observant. The garage workbench is visible in the background, lit by a fluorescent strip light.

Mid-shot, Ihsan (characters: ihsan_maker, wearing a plain black crew-neck t-shirt) turns the plastic square over in his hand. As he does, the color continues its autonomous transformation, flowing from green to a warm yellow, then slowly morphing into a soft orange. The light reflecting off its surface remains constant, proving the color change is intrinsic. He watches with focused attention.

Extreme close-up on the plastic's surface. The color shifts accelerate dramatically, pulsing through a rapid succession of vibrant hues – magenta, cyan, gold – in mesmerizing, fractal-like patterns that ripple across its surface. Brief moments of near-transparency flash across small sections. Ihsan's (characters: ihsan_maker, wearing a plain black crew-neck t-shirt) hand is just visible, holding the object steady. The light dances off the rapidly changing colors.

Medium close-up, Ihsan (characters: ihsan_maker, wearing a plain black crew-neck t-shirt) holds the plastic piece up, letting the natural daylight from a nearby window fall on it. The object gently, slowly cycles through its color spectrum again, from a deep violet to a calming blue. He observes it with a quiet, continuous fascination, allowing the impossible phenomenon to simply exist.

music: A vibrant, evolving electronic soundscape with shimmering synth textures and subtle, chromatic swells. The mood is curious and mesmerizing, with a slow, pulsating tempo. It opens with an immediate wash of shifting tones, gradually layering in more complex, interconnected harmonies that create a sense of continuous transformation, resolving into a gentle, sustained, fading chord.
